checks_passed.new_validator_warnings:
None — same 4 notice codes in both feeds, same counts and severities.
Caveat: both hosted reports (gtfs-validator 8.0.1) show ERROR-severity invalid_input_files_in_subfolder / missing_calendar_and_calendar_date_files / missing_required_file because the source zips nest all GTFS files one directory level down (e.g. Singapore_SINGAPORE_MAPKING_20260630-000/) instead of at the zip root — the validator can't find calendar.txt, stops.txt, routes.txt, trips.txt, stop_times.txt, agency.txt at the top level, so it never reaches row-level content rules.
This packaging defect is identical in both feeds (not introduced by this version) — no delta to flag — but it means this validator run does not confirm content-level checks the way a correctly-packaged feed would.
